text:
rina: dropping a quick thought on keyboard shortcut discoverability for the evals scorecard. mock attached: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/shortcut-hint-v1.png

josh: TL;DR?

rina: add a subtle hint pill near the filters: 'Shortcuts: F filter • R reorder • A approve' that expands to a modal with full cheat sheet. the pill should be keyboard focusable and announce when opened.

taylor: love the pill. a11y: the pill must be a focusable button with `aria-expanded` and open a `role=dialog` labelled "Keyboard shortcuts". also add `aria-describedby` describing what toggling does.

sam: microcopy: show `A` meaning 'Approve selected' vs 'Approve run' ambiguity. maybe list context: 'A — Approve selected (when selection present); Shift+A — Approve run'. keep it explicit.

rina: good call. we'll show context in the modal and add small inline hints next to the approve CTA like "(A)" so people learn by seeing the shortcut inline.

josh: accessibility nit: modal should trap focus and provide a Close button with `Esc` handling. when opened, announce "Keyboard shortcuts: 8 entries" via `aria-live` and move focus to modal heading.

taylor: contrast: aria_bot flagged the hint pill background too faint. make sure pill meets 3:1 ratio and the modal close control has a 4px visible target for touch.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: recommended pill bg #D9E8FF on white -> 2.8:1. Suggest #BEE0FF or increasing text weight. Also ensure each shortcut in the modal has a textual description and not just an icon.

sam: keyboard learning pattern: add an initial ephemeral banner for new users: "Tip: Press ? to open shortcuts" that disappears after first use. put banner in a `role=status` so screenreaders hear it.

rina: love it. implementation detail: `?` toggles the modal and has a small debounce to avoid accidental opens when typing in inputs. modal also shows a small "pin to header" toggle so power users can keep the pill visible.

josh: analytics: `shortcuts.open`, `shortcuts.pin_toggle`, `shortcut.used` with `shortcut_key` and `context` (e.g., scorecard, diff view). keep event names consistent with other enums.

taylor: localization note: single-key labels like '?' or 'A' can shift in some keyboard layouts. show both keycap and the action name and allow users to remap in settings. also annotate when a key isn't available on the current platform (e.g., Mac Cmd vs Ctrl).

sam: dev: make inline keycaps use `<kbd>` styling and include `aria-hidden` on decorative separators, but keep the textual description available for AT. ensure `role=dialog` modal has `aria-modal=true`.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: focus order when pinning the pill must remain logical; when pinned the pill appears in header nav and should be reachable via Skip Links. recommend adding a `Skip to shortcuts` in the header's skiplist.

rina: action items: (rina) update mock with pinned state + inline keycaps and ephemeral banner (2256789020), (sam) prototype modal with trap focus + `role=status` banner + `?` toggle, (taylor) verify contrast & mobile touch targets, (josh) add analytics enums. Thanks! :thumbsup:
